messages:
marina: Quick sync — we have a partner co-hosted hands-on on Thursday 2:00pm PT. Run-through at 1:00pm. Main goals: full demo dry-run, fallback plan verification, and final swag handoff. Who can join the 1:00pm technical dry-run?

brad: I can do 1:00pm. I'll handle swag courier & onsite pickup. courier ETA currently 11:30am per tracker. link to inventory: https://drive.google.com/swag-inventory (internal) :package:

samir: I'm in. Need to validate two things on staging: 1) model fallback route (hosted -> dedicated variant) 2) streaming chunking under 50ms token interval.

anya: I'll join for presenter cues and slide handoff. Also confirming the co-host speaker (EdgeCorp) wants a 10min deep-dive followed by a 20min live lab. Do we have network requirements for their laptop cluster?

leo: AV/infra notes: partner will bring 3 demo laptops + 1 USB NIC. We need open outbound to ports 443 and 8443 for external model telemetry to our staging. Also reserve local subnet 10.40.0.0/24 for demo routing.

marina: Good call. Brad can you confirm venue IT can open 8443 and provide a static IP? Also need a physical table for swag and a secure box for high-value items.

brad: On it — venue says they can open ports if we submit a request by tomorrow 5pm. I'll submit now. Table + lockbox confirmed. Courier will drop a sealed pallet with a packing list and manifest.

samir: For the dry-run, please use this quick smoke command to validate the fallback path:
```
# simulate short prompt then trigger fallback
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlhf-1","prompt":"hello","max_tokens":32}'
```
Expect a 200 then a second call that routes to `redwood-compact-quant` if capacity > threshold. We'll watch logs at `infra-telemetry` and `routing-decisions` streams.

anya: Presenter cue checklist for dry-run (short):
- 1:00pm join backstage Zoom (hosted link)
- 1:05pm quick mic check with EdgeCorp speaker
- 1:10pm full demo run through (samir + leo on standby)
- 1:25pm rehearse Q&A handoff and fallback messaging
- 1:30pm wrap and final swag staging

leo: I'll bring a small 5-port switch + a battery UPS for the demo table. Also, quick note: if the partner's NIC uses DHCP we should pre-assign static test IPs to avoid captive-portal delays.

marina: Great. Two outstanding items: (1) venue port request confirmation (brad) (2) final courier manifest + customs docs for international swag (if any) — Brad can you confirm ETA and include customs slip?

brad: Yes — courier ETA 11:30am, manifest attached in drive. For international swag: 20 kits flagged, customs form uploaded to the same folder. Will add tracking numbers by EOD.

samir: I'll run the fallback simulation at 12:30pm on staging and leave logs open for the dry-run. Tagging the ops-bot to trigger a quick canary snapshot at 1:15pm.

ops-bot: Canary snapshot scheduled by samir for 1768123855 (1:15pm PT). Will post status in #eng-oncall when complete. :robot_face:

anya: One more: can we create a short printed cue card for the partner speaker with the fallback script in plain language? I'll draft and share by tomorrow noon.

marina: Please share it in this thread when ready. If no blockers by EOD tomorrow we do the dry-run as planned. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
